caption:
Patience Is a Trading Skill, Not Dead Time

Patience means allowing the market to reach the conditions you have defined instead of inventing a trade because you feel pressure to act. Waiting can feel boring, especially after a loss or a missed move. But discipline is built when you follow the process even when nothing exciting is happening. Learn to value observation as much as execution.

TRADING IS NOT FOR THOSE WHO DON'T HAVE PATIENCE.  LEARN | TRADE | EARN

Educational content only. This is not financial advice. Trading involves substantial risk, and losses are possible.
